messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate alert for org=evergreen-pay (org_id: 9921). Error spike starting ~1839998800. Symptoms: elevated 429s and client timeouts on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. Affected region: eu-west-1. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/evergreen-spike

laura_oncall: ack i'm on it. assigning lead to sam_sre. sam, can you join voice?

sam_sre: joining. grabbing traces and per-org qps now. initial glance shows sustained 1.2k rps against org limit 300 rps. looks like a bulk job or runaway parallel clients. posting snippets.

jess_support: customer on the line via csm (maria). they're reporting checkout errors and a high retry rate. maria is on thread.

maria_csm: hey team - payments team reporting 502/504 intermittents during peak. they asked if we can do anything to reduce impact immediately.

sam_sre: logs: ```
2026-04-02T09:14:11Z WARN req=xy12 org=9921 status=429 route=/v1/embeddings reason=org_qps_exceeded latency_ms=320
2026-04-02T09:14:15Z ERROR req=xy13 org=9921 status=504 reason=upstream_timeout model=emb-rlarge
```

chris_prod: looks like the client SDK is retrying aggressively. also seeing a pattern from two API keys with same origin CIDR.

laura_oncall: mitigation options: 1) raise org QPS temporarily, 2) put emergency token throttle on noisy keys, 3) enable per-request circuit-breaker to reject large batch payloads, 4) fallback to cheaper embedding model. prefer minimal blast radius.

sam_sre: i recommend applying conservative org bump + token throttles + model fallback. keep for 20m and auto-revert. command (internal):
```
# emergency adjust: increase qps, set auto-expire
redwood-admin quota adjust --org 9921 --qps 900 --burst 1800 --expiry 20m --note "emergency: reduce 429s for payments flow"
```

deploy-bot: action requested: quota adjust queued by sam_sre. awaiting approval.

laura_oncall: giving thumbsup, proceed. sam apply token throttle for noisy keys too.

sam_sre: applied. change_id=chg_e9d2. Now throttling key alpha_k_77 & alpha_k_88 to 150rps each for 20m to stop retry storms. command run: ```redwood-admin token throttle set --token alpha_k_77 --qps 150 --burst 300 --expiry 20m```

incident-bot: throttle applied th_92b and th_92c. quota change chg_e9d2 in effect.

sam_sre: immediately saw 429 drop from ~28% -> ~4% for org 9921. latency dropped for critical checkout routes. overall platform GPU load increased slightly but remains within safety.

chris_prod: additionally enabled quick model fallback for embeddings: prefer emb-medium when queue depth > 250. routing rule created rchg_b44.

maria_csm: relaying to customer - finance engineering paused one suspected job and is running limited tests. they requested we keep mitigation on until they confirm normal.

laura_oncall: keep auto-expire at 20m. manual extension only if both oncall + csm approve. schedule rollback alert 5m prior.

sam_sre: noted. rollback scheduled at 1839999600 unless extended. I'll leave metric watchers unmuted and monitor error budget burn. creating follow-up INC-9921-root to track root cause and recommended SDK backoff configs.

jess_support: customer acknowledgement: "thanks, we're seeing recovery on our end. will confirm when stable."

laura_oncall: post-mitigation items: 1) postmortem with customer eng + platform to tighten client-side retries and recommend token-level alerts; 2) add automated detection for repeated large-batch jobs per-key; 3) update runbook with example admin commands and safe bump caps.

deploy-bot: scheduled auto-rollback for chg_e9d2 at 1839999600. will ping laura_oncall 5m prior.

sam_sre: closing active mitigation actions. leaving thread open for CSM confirmation and postmortem scheduling.

incident-bot: incident status=monitoring -> mitigated. last_update_by=laura_oncall. attach postmortem to auto-close.
